skill.name: self-hosted-funnel-launch
skill.description: Deploy a self-hosted funnel builder, take a funnel from empty install to published - landing page, checkout, one-click upsell, thank-you - and drive it from an agent over MCP. Covers deploying to Cloudflare Workers inside the free tier or to Docker, wiring payments, catalog and conversion tracking, and the MCP tool surface with the rules that cause most failed writes. Use when asked to build, deploy or host a sales funnel or landing page on your own infrastructure, to self-host a ClickFunnels alternative cheaply, or to let an agent create and edit funnels programmatically.
skill.summary: Deploy and operate a self-hosted sales funnel with payments, analytics, and agent-managed MCP workflows.
skill.author: autonnel

security_audit.summary: Most detections are documentation-only matches for commands, URLs, and integrations, so they are false positives for hidden execution or malicious networking. Database connection strings and production environment files are confirmed high-impact secret handling risks, and the administrative MCP endpoint needs explicit access controls before public exposure.

remediation.issue: DATABASE_URL and other production secrets are passed through shell commands and .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Use a secret manager or protected deployment secrets, restrict file permissions, disable shell tracing, and verify that secrets never enter logs, history, or version control.

remediation.issue: The administrative MCP endpoint is configured for a self-hosted public deployment without access controls established in the reviewed evidence.
remediation.suggestion: Require strong authentication, tenant-scoped authorization, TLS, and network restriction for /api/mcp; expose only the minimum write operations.

remediation.issue: Production services and container images are exposed to operator-managed infrastructure.
remediation.suggestion: Pin image and repository versions, review generated configuration, apply the database schema deliberately, and test the deployment in a restricted environment before public exposure.

content.value_statement: Teams need a low-cost way to deploy funnels, payments, and conversion tracking on infrastructure they control. This skill guides setup, publishing, and agent-managed updates through MCP.
actual_capabilities: Explains Cloudflare Workers deployment within the documented free-tier constraints.
Explains Docker Compose and pinned container deployment with Postgres.
Guides database schema setup and production secret configuration.
Maps landing, checkout, upsell, thank-you, and error funnel steps.
Provides MCP setup and operational guidance for creating and updating funnels.
limitations: It does not provision cloud accounts or purchase domains.
It does not replace payment provider, database, or email credentials.
It does not guarantee secure configuration for a public deployment.
It depends on the upstream Autonnel repository and its documented tool contracts.

use_cases.title: Solo Product Launch
use_cases.description: Deploy a focused landing page, checkout, and thank-you flow for a digital product on infrastructure you control.

use_cases.title: Agency Funnel Delivery
use_cases.description: Standardize client funnel builds with reusable page roles, payment wiring, conversion tracking, and MCP operations.

use_cases.title: Self-Hosted Experimentation
use_cases.description: Run controlled funnel experiments with Docker or Workers while retaining ownership of application data and deployment settings.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Workers and Docker for my funnel. Ask for my traffic, database, budget, and hosting constraints, then recommend one path.

prompt_templates.title: Create the Funnel Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a funnel with one landing page, one checkout, one upsell, and one thank-you page. List the required records, payment settings, and tracking checks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Production Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through a production deployment using pinned versions. Check database setup, secret handling, domain configuration, payment webhooks, and conversion events.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an MCP Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned MCP funnel workflow. Validate tool order, page roles, draft data, publish behavior, media dependencies, authentication, and rollback steps before any write.

output_examples.input: I need a simple product funnel on a small budget.
output_examples.output: A Workers deployment is recommended when the expected traffic and database workload fit the documented limits. The plan includes landing, checkout, upsell, thank-you, and tracking verification.

output_examples.input: Map these pages into a funnel: sales page, order form, bonus offer, and confirmation.
What should I verify before publishing?
output_examples.output: Verify the public domain, payment mode, webhook delivery, click identifiers, server-side conversion events, page references, and protected administrative access.

best_practices: Pin repository releases and container images before production deployment.
Protect database and encryption secrets with a managed secret store and restricted access.
Test every funnel step, payment event, tracking identifier, and administrative write in a private environment.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the administrative MCP endpoint without authentication and network controls.
Do not use latest container tags or rotate session secrets without a migration plan.
Do not publish a funnel before validating payment, webhook, tracking, and error paths.

faq.question: What does this skill deploy?
faq.answer: It guides deployment of a self-hosted funnel builder with landing, checkout, upsell, thank-you, and error page roles.

faq.question: Which hosting options are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Cloudflare Workers and Docker-based deployment with Postgres.

faq.question: Does it manage payment accounts?
faq.answer: No. It explains payment configuration, but you must supply provider accounts, credentials, and webhook settings.

faq.question: What is MCP used for?
faq.answer: MCP lets an agent inspect, create, update, and publish funnel resources through the documented administrative tool surface.

faq.question: Can I use this for public production traffic?
faq.answer: Yes, after reviewing security, secrets, authentication, domains, payment events, and provider limits for your deployment.

faq.question: What should I protect first?
faq.answer: Protect database credentials, encryption keys, session secrets, payment secrets, and the administrative MCP endpoint.
